name: utracer_nxt
notes: Ronald Dekker's uTracer NXT (500 V / 350 mA class). Values from Dekker's NXT log (dos4ever.com/uTracerlogNXT/uTracerNXT.html), read 2026-11-20: section 8 (protocol, figs 8.1-8.12), section 9 (ranges), section 6 (cathode at ground). The log is a design diary and some values change between sections; each entry says which one was used. The command and result strings have the same layout as the uTracer3 (fig. 8.1: 18 characters; the text's '28 characters' is a typo). Nothing here has been checked on an NXT.

hv_divider_top_ohm.source: Dekker NXT §9: R63 = 1M (raised from the uTracer3's 470k); the GUI lets it be calibrated 900k-1.1M

hv_divider_bottom_ohm.source: Dekker NXT §9: R64 = 9.76k, so n = 1023 gives 517 V

anode_sense_ohm.source: Dekker NXT §9: default Rs = 14.3 ohm, 350 mA range (user may parallel Rca)

neg_divider_top_ohm.source: Dekker NXT §8, fig. 8.10: R2 = 240k from the rail, R1 to +5 V

supply_volts.source: Dekker NXT §5: LEDs fed 'from the +19.5 V supply'

neg_rail_volts.source: Dekker NXT §8: firmware sets the negative boost converter to -125 V. (§2 and §5 say -105 V; §10 -145 V for the -140 V grid option.)

grid_dac_bits.source: Dekker NXT §8, fig. 8.8: MCP4921 12-bit DAC, Vg = -(R2/R1) 5/4095 n

grid_word_format.source: TO VERIFY with Dekker. Fig. 8.1 shows a 4-hex-digit grid word; the text says data words are 10 bits, which cannot hold the 12-bit DAC number. Assumed: n in bits 0-11, upper bits 0.

grid_full_scale_volts.source: Dekker NXT §8 and the My-uTracer section: R2 = 240k, R1 = 10k, gain 24, 0 to -120 V. (§9 and the calibration form say 200k / -100 V; §10 280k / -140 V.)

cathode_at_supply.source: Dekker NXT §6: 'in the uTracerNXT the cathode is referenced to ground instead of to the positive power supply voltage'

min_load_ohm.source: Dekker NXT §8, fig. 8.11: 1 Mohm minimum load on each output; the GUI subtracts V/1M from the measured current

grid_board_possible.source: Dekker NXT §8: 'The control grid voltage is always negative'

cathode_diode_drop_volts.source: Not in Dekker's NXT formulas: V = V_HV - I Rs (fig. 8.12)
